nodes.title: Algebra homomorphisms into an algebraically closed field

nodes.summary: A square of algebras is a pushout when it satisfies the universal property for algebra homomorphisms: for every `R'`-algebra `T` and every `g : S →+* T` compatible with the maps from `R`, there is a unique `R'`-algebra map `S' →ₐ[R'] T` extending `g`. The rings may lie in independent universes; it suffices to quantify `T` in the maximum of the universes of `S`, `R'`, and `S'`.
